organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Manage platform organizations: shipping companies, authorities, platform and research.

members.title: Members
members.description: Invite users and manage the roles and status of organization members.
capabilities: Change roles: org_admin, fleet_manager, authority, viewer

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: API keys for AIS pushers, telemetry devices and partners. A key is shown only once when created.
capabilities: Create keys with scopes ais:ingest, telemetry:ingest, ais:read

referenceData.title: Reference Data
referenceData.description: Vessel types, fuels, engines, fuel formulas and ports with their sources.
capabilities: Tables per kind of reference data

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Registry of telemetry devices (flow meters, MQTT gateways) and when they were last seen.
capabilities: Add devices and link an API key

auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.description: Audit trail of every service: who did what, when and from where.
capabilities: Filter by actor, action, target and time range
